questions.promptText: In commit 8f4a1 on Oct 4, you extended JWT auth token TTL from 15m to 72h with the comment '// quick fix'. No Jira ticket was linked. Why was this extended, and is it safe to revert?
AWS Secrets Manager shows you are sole custodian for Stripe Webhook Signing Secret. Who has the root 2FA backup device for the Stripe Developer Dashboard?

accessibilityAndInteraction.emptyState: When zero items are present (e.g. all contradictions settled), cards display honest empty ledger notice with 14px text and no decorative illustrations.
accessibilityAndInteraction.zeroState: Numeric zeros render honestly ('0 open conflicts', '0 unhandled blockers') without hiding digits or showing empty hyphens.
accessibilityAndInteraction.loadingState: Skeleton loading rectangles match 12-column grid geometry; no layout shifts occur during data hydration.
accessibilityAndInteraction.errorState: Error banners display actionable explanation with retry controls in 14px Geist text and 1px borders.
accessibilityAndInteraction.focusState: Interactive elements show 2px high-contrast outline (#0A0A0A) on keyboard navigation via :focus-visible.
accessibilityAndInteraction.selectedState: Selected items render with raised neutral fill (#EEEEEE) and bold text label without colored saturation.
accessibilityAndInteraction.disabledState: Disabled controls display muted ink (#6B6B6B), cursor: not-allowed, and pointer-events: none on action triggers.
accessibilityAndInteraction.keyboardNavigation: All interactive elements are reachable via Tab in DOM order; Enter and Space trigger actions.
accessibilityAndInteraction.escapeKey: Pressing Escape immediately dismisses open drawers and modals.
accessibilityAndInteraction.focusReturn: Focus returns cleanly to the triggering element upon drawer or modal closure.
accessibilityAndInteraction.reducedMotion: When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active, all 120-180ms ease-out transitions are eliminated and states render instantly.
accessibilityAndInteraction.responsiveBehavior: 12-column desktop grid collapses to 1-column stack below 768px viewport width; 55px rail collapses to bottom navigation bar on mobile.
